title: Microsoft Dataverse: run prompt columns on existing records in bulk (backfill)
summary: Hold: Microsoft Learn now says bulk processing of existing records is on by default, not off. The briefing incorrectly tells administrators that makers cannot use backfill until an administrator enables it; its default-state field and governance advice need correction. The documented control paths, AI prompts API and consumption licensing are supported.

claims.claim: The roadmap change allows prompt columns to generate AI values for existing records in bulk.
claims.quote: Prompt columns can now generate AI values for records that already exist in your table, not just new or updated ones.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes makers optionally filtering the existing records to process.
claims.quote: Makers can choose to apply a prompt to existing records in bulk, optionally filtered to just the rows they need

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Backfill is admin-opt-in and cannot be used in an environment until an administrator enables it.
claims.quote: Allow bulk processing of existing records: This is the main setting that controls running prompt on existing records in bulk in an environment. It is on by default.
claims.fix: Set defaultState to "user-opt-in": the environment gate is on by default, but a maker chooses the bulk option and selects Run prompt. Replace 'Until an admin turns it on in an environment, the bulk option is not available there' with 'The bulk-processing setting is on by default; administrators can review whether to allow it in each environment.' In Scope and the impact rationale, replace advice implying initial admin enablement with 'admins decide where to allow bulk processing'. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/data-platform/prompt-column.

claims.claim: Allow bulk processing of existing records is off by default.
claims.quote: Allow bulk processing of existing records: This is the main setting that controls running prompt on existing records in bulk in an environment. It is on by default.
claims.fix: Change 'off by default' to 'on by default' in the summary, controls[0].note and its rendered counterpart, Why it matters, Governance controls and risk rationale. Replace the At rollout instruction with 'Review bulk processing one environment at a time, starting with a non-production environment, and disable it where it should not be allowed.'
